objective: Implement export bundle creation and import preview/apply flow so local records can be exchanged through the canonical versioned JSON bundle with checksums and explicit local merge behavior.
success_criteria: Export bundle creation emits canonical versioned JSON with scope, records, and attachment manifest.
Export bundle files are written under local export storage and tracked in the exports table with checksums.
Import preview validates bundle structure before write and records preview metadata locally.
Import apply performs explicit local upsert-style merge behavior and records import decisions in the imports table.
stop_conditions: The task requires sync or remote backend behavior.
The task requires changing the canonical bundle schema in docs or schemas.
The task requires full UI flow work outside the current library package.
approval_gates: Introducing live sync instead of local bundle exchange
Changing canonical bundle format instead of implementing against it
notes: Use the canonical schema under schemas/import-export-bundle.schema.json as the contract.
Prefer explicit local merge behavior over silent destructive replacement.
